decision.summary: A multi-sample transient offset candidate begins at index 420 with concurrent downward shifts in N and E (~2–3 MAD) and a sharp U dip. N remains offset through 434 with no observed return; E shows partial recovery but not full reversion; U recovers fully by 432. Due to incomplete return in N and ambiguous E recovery within allowed context (385–470), status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets detected in this region.

intervals.observation: N: sustained downward shift from ~420 to 434 (≈2–3 MAD), no return by 435; E: similar downward shift 420–431, then partial recovery 432–434 but not to pre-420 level; U: sharp dip centered at 428–429 (~−3 MAD) with full recovery by 432. Onset coherent across axes at ~420; interior sustained; return incomplete in N, partial in E, complete in U → asymmetric transient offset.
